items.escena: A clay doorway standing alone on a base, its door swung half open, with a small clay speech bubble resting on the threshold like a welcome mat
A clay curtain drawn shut across a small stage, a tiny clay speech bubble left lying on the boards in front of it
Four identical chunky clay footprints pressed in a straight line across a flat clay path, each one exactly the same shape
A large clay hand cupped gently around a small clay cup, the cup unchanged in size but wrapped in a soft clay ribbon
A clay word tile carved with a small stepped pyramid glyph, resting on top of a plain modern clay page
A clay clock whose hand points straight up, standing inside an open clay book with an old sepia scene modelled on the page behind it
A small clay plaque with two short raised lines of text on it, hanging from a nail on an adobe wall
A clay figure with a speech bubble attached straight to its mouth, two chunky clay quotation marks standing like posts on either side
A clay dial with a pointer between two labelled end stops, one end a rough stool and the other end a polished lectern
A ring of six small clay figures sitting around a low fire, one open clay book floating just above the flame
A clay mouth on a stand releasing a long ribbon of speech that passes through three clay ears set in a row
A clay world-egg cracking open on an altar, a small sun and a small mountain rising out of the crack
A clay village well at night with a wisp of clay mist rising from it and one small clay figure peering over the rim
A clay smartphone standing upright in the dark, its screen a plain grey page of text with one thin clay shadow hand reaching around the frame
Two clay figures leaning close on a doorstep, a loose wobbly clay speech ribbon passing between them with no page in sight
